verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a dedicated reconciliation report suite (Balance Breakdown, Balance Report, Financial Actions by Date Range/Payout ID, Payouts Report, Settlement Breakdown Report, Settlement Statement) explicitly mapping settlements to underlying financial actions including fee categories, and separate refund/dispute docs cover those transaction types. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration (e.g. finance-ops user reviews) that reconciliation reports itemize chargebacks specifically and match to bank deposits in practice, and no sample report output shown.
